description: Presidential Secretariat - Amended Duties and Functions Extra Gazette No. 2187/27 On 09 th August 2020
categorisation: This gazette contains both the name of a specific individual (President Gotabaya Rajapaksa) and detailed descriptions of portfolio responsibilities, institutional frameworks, and specific laws/acts to be implemented by various government bodies. The content outlines the assignment of functions to specific institutions (Presidential Task Forces, departments, and statutory bodies) and explicitly lists the laws and ordinances each entity is responsible for implementing, meeting the criteria for a Hybrid Gazette (Type 3).
